sql.query:
-- Absorbs raw schema evolution: order_total (r1-r2) was renamed order_amount (r3+); retried rows are de-duplicated.
with ranked as (
    select
        *,
        row_number() over (partition by order_id order by _loaded_at desc) as rn
    from "orders"."raw"."orders"
)

select
    cast(order_id as varchar) as order_id,
    cast(customer_id as varchar) as customer_id,
    cast(order_ts as timestamp) as order_ts,
    cast(coalesce(order_amount, order_total) as decimal(12, 2)) as order_amount,
    cast(discount_amount as decimal(12, 2)) as discount_amount,
    cast(currency as varchar) as currency,
    cast(status as varchar) as status,
    cast(sales_channel as varchar) as sales_channel,
    cast(_loaded_at as timestamp) as loaded_at
from ranked
where rn = 1

sql.query:
-- Dual-published v1 (contract 1.1.0) derived from v2 until its deprecation date.
-- Keeps the old column name and the old status domain so v1 consumers see no change.
select
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    order_ts,
    order_date,
    order_amount as order_total,
    currency,
    case when status = 'returned' then 'completed' else status end as status,
    sales_channel,
    loaded_at
from "orders"."main"."fct_orders_v2"

sql.query:
-- Absorbs raw schema evolution: dollars `amount` (r1) became integer `amount_cents` (r2).
select
    cast(payment_id as varchar) as payment_id,
    cast(order_id as varchar) as order_id,
    cast(paid_at as timestamp) as paid_at,
    cast(coalesce(amount_cents / 100.0, amount) as decimal(12, 2)) as amount,
    cast(currency as varchar) as currency,
    cast(status as varchar) as status,
    cast(payment_method as varchar) as payment_method,
    cast(_loaded_at as timestamp) as loaded_at
from "payments"."raw"."payments"

sql.query:
-- Absorbs raw schema evolution: `carrier` (r1) was renamed `carrier_code` (r2).
select
    cast(shipment_id as varchar) as shipment_id,
    cast(order_id as varchar) as order_id,
    cast(coalesce(carrier_code, carrier) as varchar) as carrier,
    cast(carrier_service as varchar) as carrier_service,
    cast(shipped_at as timestamp) as shipped_at,
    cast(delivered_at as timestamp) as delivered_at,
    cast(promised_date as date) as promised_date,
    cast(_loaded_at as timestamp) as loaded_at
from "logistics"."raw"."shipments"

-- Absorbs raw schema evolution: `carrier` (r1) was renamed `carrier_code` (r2).
select
    cast(shipment_id as varchar) as shipment_id,
    cast(order_id as varchar) as order_id,
    cast(coalesce(carrier_code, carrier) as varchar) as carrier,
    cast(carrier_service as varchar) as carrier_service,
    cast(shipped_at as timestamp) as shipped_at,
    cast(delivered_at as timestamp) as delivered_at,
    cast(promised_date as date) as promised_date,
    cast(_loaded_at as timestamp) as loaded_at
from "logistics"."raw"."shipments"

select
    shipment_id,
    order_id,
    carrier,
    carrier_service,
    shipped_at,
    delivered_at,
    promised_date,
    cast(delivered_at as date) <= promised_date as is_on_time,
    loaded_at
from "logistics"."main"."stg_shipments"

sql.query:
select
    shp.order_id,
    bool_and(shp.is_on_time) as delivered_on_time
from "logistics"."main"."fct_shipments_v1" as shp
group by shp.order_id

select
    shp.order_id,
    bool_and(shp.is_on_time) as delivered_on_time
from "logistics"."main"."fct_shipments_v1" as shp
group by shp.order_id

select
    pay.order_id,
    sum(case when pay.status = 'captured' then pay.amount else 0 end) as captured_amount,
    sum(case when pay.status = 'refunded' then pay.amount else 0 end) as refunded_amount
from "payments"."main"."fct_payments_v1" as pay
where pay.order_id is not null
group by pay.order_id

select
    pay.order_id,
    sum(case when pay.status = 'captured' then pay.amount else 0 end) as captured_amount,
    sum(case when pay.status = 'refunded' then pay.amount else 0 end) as refunded_amount
from "payments"."main"."fct_payments_v1" as pay
where pay.order_id is not null
group by pay.order_id

-- Gold cross-domain mart: one row per order date.
select
    o.order_date,
    count(*) as orders,
    cast(sum(o.order_amount) as decimal(14, 2)) as gmv,
    cast(sum(coalesce(p.captured_amount, 0) - coalesce(p.refunded_amount, 0)) as decimal(14, 2)) as net_revenue,
    avg(case when f.delivered_on_time then 1.0 when not f.delivered_on_time then 0.0 end) as on_time_delivery_rate
from "orders"."main"."fct_orders_v2" as o
left join "analytics"."main"."int_order_payments" as p on o.order_id = p.order_id
left join "analytics"."main"."int_order_fulfilment" as f on o.order_id = f.order_id
group by o.order_date

-- Gold cross-domain mart: one row per order date.
select
    o.order_date,
    count(*) as orders,
    cast(sum(o.order_amount) as decimal(14, 2)) as gmv,
    cast(sum(coalesce(p.captured_amount, 0) - coalesce(p.refunded_amount, 0)) as decimal(14, 2)) as net_revenue,
    avg(case when f.delivered_on_time then 1.0 when not f.delivered_on_time then 0.0 end) as on_time_delivery_rate
from "orders"."main"."fct_orders_v2" as o
left join "analytics"."main"."int_order_payments" as p on o.order_id = p.order_id
left join "analytics"."main"."int_order_fulfilment" as f on o.order_id = f.order_id
group by o.order_date

-- A legacy dashboard that still reads the deprecated v1 interface (it uses order_total).
-- The deprecation report in results/ finds it from OpenLineage events, before v1 is retired.
select
    o1.order_date,
    sum(o1.order_total) as completed_revenue
from "orders"."main"."fct_orders_v1" as o1
where o1.status = 'completed'
group by o1.order_date
